title: Kiondo Patterns
author: Somo team (XPRIZE Kenya)
description: Finish the bead pattern on the kiondo strap: AB, ABB, ABC. Level 3: growing number patterns like 2, 4, 6.
description_sw: Malizia mfumo wa shanga kwenye kamba ya kiondo: AB, ABB, ABC. Kiwango 3: mifumo ya namba inayokua kama 2, 4, 6.

lines.en: Tap the green button to start.
Say the pattern out loud: {p}. What comes next?
lines.sw: Taja mfumo kwa sauti: {p}. Nini kinafuata?

lines.en: Beads for the kiondo strap! Look at the pattern and choose the next bead.
lines.sw: Shanga za kamba ya kiondo! Angalia mfumo na uchague shanga inayofuata.

lines.en: Harder patterns now. Say the colours out loud.
lines.sw: Mifumo migumu zaidi sasa. Taja rangi kwa sauti.

lines.en: Now number patterns that grow. Find the jump.
lines.sw: Sasa mifumo ya namba inayokua. Tafuta kuruka.

lines.en: How much bigger is each number? Count the jump.
lines.sw: Kila namba ni kubwa kwa kiasi gani? Hesabu kuruka.

lines.en: The part that repeats is {u}. So next is {a}.
lines.sw: Sehemu inayojirudia ni {u}. Kwa hiyo inayofuata ni {a}.

lines.en: Each time it goes up by {j}. {last} and {j} more is {a}.
lines.sw: Kila mara inaongezeka kwa {j}. {last} na {j} zaidi ni {a}.
